title: POST /process-groups/{id}/connections - Request
description: Creates a new connection within a process group

id.description: The ID of the source component

groupId.description: The ID of the group containing the source component

type.description: The type of the source component (e.g., PROCESSOR, INPUT_PORT)

id.description: The ID of the destination component

groupId.description: The ID of the group containing the destination component

type.description: The type of the destination component (e.g., PROCESSOR, OUTPUT_PORT)

selectedRelationships.description: The relationships to include in this connection

backPressureObjectThreshold.description: The maximum number of objects that can be queued before back pressure is applied

backPressureDataSizeThreshold.description: The maximum data size before back pressure is applied (e.g., '1 GB')

flowFileExpiration.description: The amount of time a FlowFile may exist before it expires (e.g., '0 sec')
